title: Algorithms for hyperelliptic Mumford Curves $p$-adic Uniformization, $p$-adic integrals and $p$-adic heights
summary: Mumford curves generalize the Tate uniformization of elliptic curves with split multiplicative reduction and provide p-adic analogues of the uniformization of Riemann surfaces. In this paper, we present several algorithms for hyperelliptic Mumford curves. For a given hyperelliptic Mumford curve $X$ defined over a finite extension of the field of p-adic numbers for some $p\neq 2$, we first describe how to compute a p-adic Schottky group W that uniformizes X; this is based on our extension to Kadziela's approximation theorem.
